info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Loyalty Loyalty Earn-v5-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Earn API facilitates the seamless addition of loyalty points for customers, enhancing their engagement with the brand. This endpoint allows businesses to reward their customers by registering earned loyalty points based on specific transactions or interactions. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, retail systems, and customer relationship management tools that aim to incentivize customer loyalty through point rewards. By leveraging this API, businesses can easily manage loyalty point allocations and improve customer retention strategies.

post.summary: Earn loyalty points for eligible purchases.
post.description: This operation allows users to earn loyalty points based on their purchases. Points can be redeemed later for rewards or discounts. Ensure that the purchase meets the eligibility criteria set forth in the loyalty program.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a loyalty earn operation, which allows a user to earn loyalty points based on their transactions or activities. Ensure that the request contains all necessary data according to the specified schema to successfully process the earning operation.
